@concat('DECLARE @root varchar(36) = ''',pipeline().RunId,''';
IF TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,@root) IS NULL
    THROW 51600, ''Pipeline RunId invalido.'', 1;
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m05.attempt WHERE root_run_id=@root)
    THROW 51602, ''Baseline ausente.'', 1;
IF (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM m05.guard_facts WHERE root_run_id=@root)
       <> (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM gold.published_business_bytes)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT * FROM m05.guard_facts WHERE root_run_id=@root EXCEPT SELECT @root,* FROM gold.published_business_bytes)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT @root,* FROM gold.published_business_bytes EXCEPT SELECT * FROM m05.guard_facts WHERE root_run_id=@root)
    THROW 51603, ''Publicacao anterior mudou: facts.'', 1;
IF (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM m05.guard_posto WHERE root_run_id=@root)
       <> (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM (SELECT CAST(posto_sk AS varbinary(8000)) AS posto_sk,CAST(cnpj AS varbinary(8000)) AS cnpj,CAST(revenda_observada AS varbinary(8000)) AS revenda_observada,CAST(bandeira_observada AS varbinary(8000)) AS bandeira_observada,CAST(municipio_ibge AS varbinary(8000)) AS municipio_ibge,CAST(uf AS varbinary(8000)) AS uf,observado_desde,observado_ate FROM gold.dim_posto) AS current_state)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT * FROM m05.guard_posto WHERE root_run_id=@root EXCEPT SELECT @root,* FROM (SELECT CAST(posto_sk AS varbinary(8000)) AS posto_sk,CAST(cnpj AS varbinary(8000)) AS cnpj,CAST(revenda_observada AS varbinary(8000)) AS revenda_observada,CAST(bandeira_observada AS varbinary(8000)) AS bandeira_observada,CAST(municipio_ibge AS varbinary(8000)) AS municipio_ibge,CAST(uf AS varbinary(8000)) AS uf,observado_desde,observado_ate FROM gold.dim_posto) AS current_state)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT @root,* FROM (SELECT CAST(posto_sk AS varbinary(8000)) AS posto_sk,CAST(cnpj AS varbinary(8000)) AS cnpj,CAST(revenda_observada AS varbinary(8000)) AS revenda_observada,CAST(bandeira_observada AS varbinary(8000)) AS bandeira_observada,CAST(municipio_ibge AS varbinary(8000)) AS municipio_ibge,CAST(uf AS varbinary(8000)) AS uf,observado_desde,observado_ate FROM gold.dim_posto) AS current_state EXCEPT SELECT * FROM m05.guard_posto WHERE root_run_id=@root)
    THROW 51603, ''Publicacao anterior mudou: posto.'', 1;
IF (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM m05.guard_publication WHERE root_run_id=@root)
       <> (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM (SELECT CAST(batch_id AS varbinary(8000)) AS batch_id,CAST(scope_id AS varbinary(8000)) AS scope_id,CAST(source_sha256 AS varbinary(8000)) AS source_sha256,CAST(ibge_sha256 AS varbinary(8000)) AS ibge_sha256,silver_delta_version,is_synthetic,published_at_utc,rows_published,CAST(source_table AS varbinary(8000)) AS source_table,CAST(snapshot_id AS varbinary(8000)) AS snapshot_id FROM gold.publication) AS current_state)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT * FROM m05.guard_publication WHERE root_run_id=@root EXCEPT SELECT @root,* FROM (SELECT CAST(batch_id AS varbinary(8000)) AS batch_id,CAST(scope_id AS varbinary(8000)) AS scope_id,CAST(source_sha256 AS varbinary(8000)) AS source_sha256,CAST(ibge_sha256 AS varbinary(8000)) AS ibge_sha256,silver_delta_version,is_synthetic,published_at_utc,rows_published,CAST(source_table AS varbinary(8000)) AS source_table,CAST(snapshot_id AS varbinary(8000)) AS snapshot_id FROM gold.publication) AS current_state)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT @root,* FROM (SELECT CAST(batch_id AS varbinary(8000)) AS batch_id,CAST(scope_id AS varbinary(8000)) AS scope_id,CAST(source_sha256 AS varbinary(8000)) AS source_sha256,CAST(ibge_sha256 AS varbinary(8000)) AS ibge_sha256,silver_delta_version,is_synthetic,published_at_utc,rows_published,CAST(source_table AS varbinary(8000)) AS source_table,CAST(snapshot_id AS varbinary(8000)) AS snapshot_id FROM gold.publication) AS current_state EXCEPT SELECT * FROM m05.guard_publication WHERE root_run_id=@root)
    THROW 51603, ''Publicacao anterior mudou: publication.'', 1;
IF (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM m05.guard_calendar WHERE root_run_id=@root)
       <> (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM (SELECT data_sk,data,inicio_semana_iso,ano_iso,semana_iso FROM gold.dim_data) AS current_state)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT * FROM m05.guard_calendar WHERE root_run_id=@root EXCEPT SELECT @root,* FROM (SELECT data_sk,data,inicio_semana_iso,ano_iso,semana_iso FROM gold.dim_data) AS current_state)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT @root,* FROM (SELECT data_sk,data,inicio_semana_iso,ano_iso,semana_iso FROM gold.dim_data) AS current_state EXCEPT SELECT * FROM m05.guard_calendar WHERE root_run_id=@root)
    THROW 51603, ''Publicacao anterior mudou: calendar.'', 1;
IF (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM m05.guard_municipios WHERE root_run_id=@root)
       <> (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM (SELECT CAST(municipio_ibge AS varbinary(8000)) AS municipio_ibge,CAST(nome AS varbinary(8000)) AS nome,CAST(uf AS varbinary(8000)) AS uf FROM gold.dim_municipio) AS current_state)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT * FROM m05.guard_municipios WHERE root_run_id=@root EXCEPT SELECT @root,* FROM (SELECT CAST(municipio_ibge AS varbinary(8000)) AS municipio_ibge,CAST(nome AS varbinary(8000)) AS nome,CAST(uf AS varbinary(8000)) AS uf FROM gold.dim_municipio) AS current_state)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT @root,* FROM (SELECT CAST(municipio_ibge AS varbinary(8000)) AS municipio_ibge,CAST(nome AS varbinary(8000)) AS nome,CAST(uf AS varbinary(8000)) AS uf FROM gold.dim_municipio) AS current_state EXCEPT SELECT * FROM m05.guard_municipios WHERE root_run_id=@root)
    THROW 51603, ''Publicacao anterior mudou: municipios.'', 1;
IF (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM m05.guard_produtos WHERE root_run_id=@root)
       <> (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM (SELECT produto_sk,CAST(produto AS varbinary(8000)) AS produto,CAST(moeda AS varbinary(8000)) AS moeda,CAST(unidade AS varbinary(8000)) AS unidade FROM gold.dim_produto) AS current_state)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT * FROM m05.guard_produtos WHERE root_run_id=@root EXCEPT SELECT @root,* FROM (SELECT produto_sk,CAST(produto AS varbinary(8000)) AS produto,CAST(moeda AS varbinary(8000)) AS moeda,CAST(unidade AS varbinary(8000)) AS unidade FROM gold.dim_produto) AS current_state)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT @root,* FROM (SELECT produto_sk,CAST(produto AS varbinary(8000)) AS produto,CAST(moeda AS varbinary(8000)) AS moeda,CAST(unidade AS varbinary(8000)) AS unidade FROM gold.dim_produto) AS current_state EXCEPT SELECT * FROM m05.guard_produtos WHERE root_run_id=@root)
    THROW 51603, ''Publicacao anterior mudou: produtos.'', 1;
SELECT ''m05_previous_publication_unchanged'' AS status,@root AS root_run_id;
')
